keepalive.title: Keep App Alive
keepalive.rowDesc: Prevent system from killing the app for more reliable timers
keepalive.statusEnabledHint: The app is excluded from battery optimizations. Background kills are significantly less likely.
keepalive.statusDisabledHint: The system may force-stop the app when the screen is off or memory is tight, interrupting timers and delaying reminders.
keepalive.dialogOpened: Tap "Allow" in the popup to enable
keepalive.fallbackToAppInfo: Please enable manually in App Info (see guide below)
keepalive.openFailed: Cannot open system settings. Please open it manually.
keepalive.romGuide1: In App Info → Battery management, choose "Unrestricted / Always allow background activity"
keepalive.romGuide2: In Recents (overview) screen, long-press the app card → tap the 🔒 lock icon
keepalive.romGuide3: In Security / Phone Manager app → Auto-start manager, allow this app to auto-start
keepalive.romGuide4: Xiaomi/Redmi: Settings → Apps → Permissions → Autostart. Huawei: Phone Manager → Startup manager, turn off auto-manage and allow background manually.
keepalive.romGuideNote: Menu labels vary by ROM. These 4 steps cover most cases. Android does not allow 100% guaranteed immunity from being killed.
